description.value: Private RV park on Highway 3 in downtown Creston with flush showers, laundry, and WiFi; tenting is available at a flat rate, and the location puts restaurants, shops, and community trails within walking distance with Kootenay Lake 20 minutes away.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pairadicepark.com was fully fetched and provides rich, explicit amenity detail. Free showers, laundromat facilities, tenting accommodation, on-site Wi-Fi, and walk-to restaurants are all confirmed by name in the front-page and About-page text. The business name on the website ('Pair-a-Dice RV Park' / 'Pair A Dice Park') differs from the OSM tag ('Pair-A-Dice RV Campground'), which is flagged; per the rules, the OSM name is retained verbatim. OSM carries no phone or address, so those fields are sourced from the website and contact_confirmed is null for both.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Pair-A-Dice RV Campground' but the website consistently uses 'Pair-a-Dice RV Park' and 'Pair A Dice Park'; OSM name retained per rules.
OSM carries no phone number or address; both are sourced solely from the website, so contact_confirmed.phone and contact_confirmed.address are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A year-round campground with tenting, free showers, and on-site laundry directly on Highway 3 in the Kootenays — strong infrastructure for touring cyclists on a major BC route.

wow_evidence: flush showers, laundry, and WiFi; tenting is available
